prerequisites: Install Instrilo v0.2.3 or newer from a release. Check instrilo --version, then prepare the tutorial workspace as shown below.
Use Bash on macOS/Linux or WSL, inside your prepared tutorial workspace. Keep every step in the same terminal.
Use a fresh tutorial project name. If init/create says the project already exists, choose a new slug and update INSTRILO_PROJECT; do not delete work you want to keep.
Install uv and Python 3.11–3.13 before this guide. uv may discover or download a compatible interpreter; generated projects declare >=3.11,<3.14.
If uv must use a particular installed interpreter, set NB_AGENT_PYTHON to its absolute executable path before prepare.

title: Create a Python agent from existing guidance
summary: Bring a folder of product decisions and generate a runnable Python project.
outcome: A Python agent with a copied, fingerprinted product-guidance directory and a verified local invocation.

verification.scope: The shown commands inspect an existing guidance folder, copy it into a new Python project, install declared dependencies through uv, and run the generated Python runtime. The bundled verify.mjs helper only reads saved JSON and asserts the expected results.
limitations: The runtime uses an offline echo provider; this validates Python execution and guidance packaging, not task quality.
No real account is accessed. uv preparation requires package-registry access and a compatible Python interpreter.

steps.title: Check Python tooling and inspect the brief
steps.body: The supplied folder represents your existing product documentation. Credentials and other excluded files should stay outside guidance. The inspector inventories eligible text and reports missing decisions.
steps.code:
set -eu
INSTRILO_PROJECT=.studio/tutorials/python-from-guidance
uv --version
instrilo guidance inspect examples/quickstarts/foundations/guidance > /dev/null
instrilo guidance inspect examples/quickstarts/foundations/guidance
steps.expected: uv prints its version. Guidance inspection finds product.md and no missing product sections.

steps.title: Create a Python project from that folder
steps.body: Create copies eligible guidance files into the new project. The original folder remains your input, while this project owns its copy.
steps.code:
instrilo create python-from-guidance --directory .studio/tutorials --guidance examples/quickstarts/foundations/guidance --language python --framework native --target local
cmp examples/quickstarts/foundations/guidance/product.md "$INSTRILO_PROJECT/guidance/product.md"
instrilo validate "$INSTRILO_PROJECT"
steps.expected: The CLI reports one guidance file, cmp confirms an exact copy, and validation reports valid: true.

steps.title: Build and install generated dependencies
steps.body: Prepare uses uv sync in the generated project and creates its .venv. It may download packages; it does not install provider CLIs or sign into accounts.
steps.code:
instrilo build "$INSTRILO_PROJECT"
instrilo prepare "$INSTRILO_PROJECT"
test -f "$INSTRILO_PROJECT/generated/agent.py"
test -f "$INSTRILO_PROJECT/generated/pyproject.toml"
steps.expected: agent.py and pyproject.toml exist. uv successfully creates the generated environment.

steps.title: Run the generated Python agent
steps.body: Instrilo automatically uses the generated virtual environment. The explicit demo prefix demonstrates that no inference request occurred.
steps.code:
instrilo run "$INSTRILO_PROJECT" --input 'Explain the shop return policy.' > "$INSTRILO_PROJECT/run.json"
cat "$INSTRILO_PROJECT/run.json"
node examples/quickstarts/foundations/verify.mjs offline-python "$INSTRILO_PROJECT"
steps.expected: The result is “[DEMO ONLY] Explain the shop return policy.” with a recorded model step.

troubleshooting: If preparation cannot reach npm/PyPI, fix registry/proxy access and repeat prepare; it does not require model credentials.
If the project already exists, inspect or keep it and choose a new tutorial slug. Do not rerun init over an existing manifest.
If uv is missing, install it from the official uv installation guide. If Python selection fails, use an installed Python 3.11–3.13 executable through NB_AGENT_PYTHON and repeat prepare.
cleanup: No service remains running. The generated .venv belongs to this tutorial project; keep it to run again.
